result.topic_en: The page ends a number-theoretic argument, asks how the quadratic extension obtained from the roots of a cubic equation relates to the cubic base field, and sets out a plan to apply the ideal concept to all mathematical disciplines, as Lie did with the group concept.

items.quote:
Welches
Verhältniss hat dieser relativ quadratische
Körper zu dem cubischen Grundkörper?
items.english: What relationship does this relatively quadratic field have to the cubic base field?

items.quote:
Ist es etwa die Quadratwurzel aus einem
Idealquadrat?
items.english: Is it perhaps the square root of an ideal square?

items.quote:
{+wie+} Wenn jener cubische Körper
die Relativdiskriminante 1 besitzt?
items.english: How, if that cubic field has relative discriminant 1?

items.quote:
Wie Lie den Gruppenbegriff, so will ich den
Idealbegriff auf alle mathem. Disciplinen
anwenden, insbesondere auf die Functionentheorie
und die Theorie der Differentialgleichung.
items.english: As Lie did with the concept of group, I want to apply the concept of ideal to all mathematical disciplines, in particular to the theory of functions and the theory of differential equations.

items.quote:
Viel-
leicht kommt beides auf dasselbe hinaus, vergl.
meinen Brief an Klein vom 15 Dec. 1894.
items.english: Perhaps both come to the same thing; compare my letter to Klein of 15 Dec. 1894.
